text:
Alyssa: Monitoring alert - northamerica-west2 GPU autoscaler failing to start new nodes, image pull failures spiking (ImagePullBackOff, 429s) over last 10m. Startup failure rate 52%.
Devon: Oncall here, seeing 429s from our mirror registry during scale-up. Fallback mirror not being used due to a retry/backoff bug. Investigating.
Marco: Quick question - are Dedicated/reserved pools affected or only hosted burst autoscaling?
Alyssa: Reserved pools appear healthy. This is hitting burst/free autoscale groups that pull the common worker image.
Sarah-CS: We already have three support threads from customers in NA-West reporting latency/errors. Need an ETA for mitigation to share.
Oliver: Immediate mitigation proposal: shift new inference traffic from na-west2 -> na-east1 via routing weight change. Prioritize reserved capacity so SLA customers don't see regression. Note: cross-region egress costs may spike.
Ryan: Approve the reroute for customer stability. :thumbsup:
Alyssa: Applying routing override now. Setting na-west2 weight=0.0, na-east1 weight=1.0 for gen and chat endpoints, TTL for caches lowered.
Alyssa: Command I ran:
```bash
kubectl -n redwood patch configmap routing-policy -p '{"data":{"gen-weight":"na-east1=1,na-west2=0","chat-weight":"na-east1=1,na-west2=0"}}'
```
Ops-bot: router-bot applied routing override to service/gen & service/chat: OK (commit abc123).
Devon: Traffic drain observed in na-west2: new session rate down ~95%. Existing long-lived sessions still on old nodes until eviction. Backend KV cache traffic will persist for a bit.
Sarah-CS: Drafting status page update: root cause = "image registry rate limiting causing autoscaler failures"; status = "degraded"; mitigation = "traffic shifted to na-east1"; ETA for next update = 30m. Will post once reroute confirmed.
Oliver: Also loop in Sales/Pricing to tell reserved customers about potential egress exposure and offer options (credit, temporary Dedicated traffic pin, etc.).
Marco: Added a temporary router policy to prefer Dedicated by tag. Snippet:
```json
{"route_priority":[{"tag":"reserved","weight":1.0},{"tag":"default","weight":0.5}]}
```
Maya-Pricing: Suggest auto-crediting impacted burst traffic in NA-West. Proposed 10% credit for any customer whose requests were served from alternate region during incident window.
Sarah-CS: We'll hold credits as a post-incident action - coordinate once we have final impact numbers. For now customers want an ETA.
Devon: Root cause summary: mirror failover logic didn't fallback to global registry because of an edge-case in our backoff/retry code. Fix PR ready; plan is to roll image-manager + autoscaler patch. Targeting rollout in ~45 minutes, follow with controlled traffic return.
Ryan: Assign postmortem owner?
Devon: I'll own the postmortem. Tagging @Oliver @Maya-Pricing @Sarah-CS for follow-up.
statuspage-bot: Posted incident update: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/NA-WEST-2026-03-18 (status: investigating -> degraded; mitigation: traffic reroute in progress).
Ops-bot: monitoring note: image pull success rate in na-west2 improving to 85% over last 5m after upstream mirror retries increased.
Alyssa: Observed gradual node stabilization; autoscaler reconciliation running.
Devon: ETA for full traffic return to na-west2: ~90 minutes pending successful autoscaler reconcile and node health checks. Will update earlier if it changes.
Sarah-CS: I'll send a short support template to Customer Ops to push out ETA + courtesy note.
Maya-Pricing: I'll prepare provisional credit calc and notify finance.
Ryan: Good work team. Keep updates here every 15m or on change.
Devon: Will send status update after the patch and once we see consistent image pulls for 2 consecutive reconciliation cycles.
Alyssa: Noting for the record: cost delta estimate while rerouted ~ $12k/day in egress if sustained.
Ops-bot: Incident channel archived note scheduled after closure.
